name: Petitioner, Terrorized (Ethereal Plane)
body:
This sickly-looking humanoid has oddly disproportionate joints.

Terrorized
CR 1

XP 400
Human petitioner
NE Medium outsider (extraplanar)
Init +0; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 10, touch 10, flat-footed 10
hp 16 (2d10+5)
Fort +4, Ref +3, Will +0
Immune death effects, disease, mind-affecting effects, poison

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee slam +2 (1d4)

STATISTICS

Str 11, Dex 10, Con 13, Int 10, Wis 11, Cha 10
Base Atk +2; CMB +2; CMD 12
Feats Toughness
Skills Intimidate +2, Knowledge (planes) +5, Perception +5, Sense Motive +5, Stealth +5, Survival +2
Languages Common

ABOUT

When a mortal dies, its soul is judged and sent on to the afterlife where it becomes a petitioner.
